problem.insecureUrl: Change the server URL in Settings → Obsttorte to one that starts with https://.
problem.network: Could not reach the server. Check your network and the server URL.
problem.unauthorized: The server rejected the device token. If this device was revoked, issue a new token with obsttorte device add.
problem.forbidden: Cloudflare Access rejected the request. Check the Access Client ID and Client Secret.
problem.version: The server and the plugin versions do not match. Update the older one.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
problem.maintenance: The server is undergoing maintenance. Try again later.
problem.notObsttorte: The response did not come from Obsttorte. Check the server URL and the Access credentials.
problem.unknown: Sync failed for an unknown reason.
problem.local-shrunk: Sync stopped because this device has far fewer files than last time. Check that the vault folder is intact, then sync again.
problem.empty-remote: Sync stopped because the server has no files, although this device synced with it before. Check that the server URL is correct.

initial.intro: This device has not synced with this server yet. Choose how to combine its files with the server’s. Sync won’t start until you choose.
initial.mergeDesc: Keep the files from both sides. Files that differ become conflicts that you resolve one by one. Nothing is deleted.
initial.serverDesc: Make this device match the server. A snapshot of this device’s files is saved first.
initial.deviceDesc: Make the server match this device. Your other devices receive these changes on their next sync.
initial.push: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to send to the server
initial.pull: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to receive from the server
initial.deleteLocal: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to delete from this device
initial.deleteRemote: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to delete from the server

guard.shrinkToZero: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} would become empty.

pluginData.title: Choose which plugin settings to sync
pluginData.intro: These plugins keep their settings in data.json. Settings can contain tokens or paths that only work on one device, so Obsttorte asks before syncing them. You can change this later under Plugins and settings.

log.rejected.pathCollision: Rejected: the path collides with another file

quarantine.intro: Another device changed code, or settings that can run code. Approve only if you made this change yourself.
quarantine.changed: The content changed while you were reviewing it, so it was not approved. Review the new content.
quarantine.newPluginDesc: This plugin is not on this device yet. Approving installs its code here.
purge.intro: Remove a file, its history, and its copies in snapshots from the server. Use this for content that must not stay there, such as a leaked password. This cannot be undone. Copies already on your devices stay until you delete them on each device.
purge.pathDesc: The path inside the vault, such as notes/secret.md.
purge.confirmName: To confirm, type the name of this device: {device}
purge.done: Deleted {objects, plural, one {# version} other {# versions}} ({bytes}) from the server.
settings.serverUrlDesc: The URL that obsttorte setup printed.
settings.accessClientIdDesc: The Client ID of the service token you created in Cloudflare Zero Trust.
settings.accessClientSecretDesc: Shown only once, when you created the service token. Stored in Obsidian’s secret storage, not in the vault.
settings.deviceTokenDesc: Printed by obsttorte setup or obsttorte device add. Stored in Obsidian’s secret storage, not in the vault.
settings.checkDesc: Check that the server accepts the values above.
settings.syncModeDesc: With Send only, this device doesn’t receive changes. With Receive only, it doesn’t send them.
settings.intervalDesc: How often to sync automatically while Obsidian is open. Edits are also sent 30 seconds after you stop typing, and on mobile when you leave the app.
settings.exportPlanDesc: Copy the plan for the next sync to the clipboard as JSON, for troubleshooting.
settings.autoMergeDesc: Merge edits to different parts of the same file automatically. When off, every file edited on both sides becomes a conflict.
settings.maxDeletionsDesc: Ask before a sync deletes more files than this.
settings.maxDeletionRatioDesc: Ask before a sync deletes more than this percentage of the vault.
settings.maxChangeRatioDesc: Ask before a sync changes more than this percentage of the vault.
settings.shrinkToZeroDesc: Ask before a sync empties more files than this. Only files of 1 KB or more count.
settings.pluginDataDesc: Choose whether each plugin’s data.json syncs to every device. It can contain tokens or paths that only work on one device. If you haven’t chosen, Obsttorte asks before syncing it.
settings.codePluginsDesc: Plugin IDs, one per line, whose settings can run code. Changes to their settings wait for your approval on each device.
settings.exclusionPatternsDesc: Paths that never sync, one glob pattern per line. * matches within a folder and ** matches across folders.
settings.fixedExclusionsDesc: These paths never sync, regardless of the patterns above.
settings.dailyDaysDesc: Keep one snapshot per day for this many days.
settings.monthlyMonthsDesc: Keep one snapshot per month for this many months.
settings.deviceDaysDesc: Keep snapshots that a device saved, such as before switching to the server’s files, for this many days.
settings.registeredDevicesDesc: Add devices with obsttorte device add, and revoke them with obsttorte device revoke.
settings.logVerbosityDesc: Detailed also lists unchanged and excluded files, with their checksums.
settings.rebuildIndexDesc: Forget which files this device has synced. The next sync starts over and asks how this device should join.
validate.url: Enter a URL that starts with https://.
validate.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number of {min} or more.
